reason: Does not fit bank 4's room in the DEBUG_FULLREDRAW build, the full-redraw oracle the proof gate needs (worldrun/scrollleft/kcguard controls). Measured 2026-10-23: the candidate applied to HEAD 9f97ad5's src/render.6502 in a scratch copy; the shipping and gameplay builds assemble, but make DEFINES=DEBUG_FULLREDRAW fails: 'src/main.6502:151:5: error: bank 4 overruns the renderer's workspace by 14' (that build's bank 4 already ends at &B3F9, 7 bytes under REN_BASE &B400; the candidate adds 21). Even without the 12-byte pad (ALT 3, +9) it overruns by 2. The logic itself looked equivalent (same A = count-1 into SEC/ADC #2/ADC col_ptr, SBC (col_ptr) at the old pointer, Y/A/C dead after on_same_page, col_ptr renderer scratch &C7/&C8 not read by the interrupt, no entries past labels), but a change that breaks a flag combination's assembly fails SKILL.md 'Room'. Also the 12-byte pad is alignment tuned to one layout (measured on 3db31c8 shipping bench), which other flag builds and any earlier kept change move.
